_about: Per-resource security checks (the Nessus-style layer). Base severity is fixed per check and editable here; a check may raise or lower it for a stated reason (e.g. IMDSv1 on an instance that carries a role). 'cis' maps to the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0 where one applies. Cleave's own ranking on top (on an attack path first) is applied in findings/engine.py, not here.

IAM.ROOT_MFA.title: Root account has no MFA
IAM.ROOT_MFA.remediation: Enable MFA on the root user (a hardware key is best), then stop using root for daily work.

IAM.ROOT_KEYS.title: Root account has access keys
IAM.ROOT_KEYS.remediation: Delete the root user's access keys. Use IAM roles or users with scoped permissions instead.

IAM.ROOT_RECENTLY_USED.title: Root account used in the last 90 days
IAM.ROOT_RECENTLY_USED.remediation: Do daily administration through IAM identities; keep root for the few tasks that require it.

IAM.USER_NO_MFA.title: Console user without MFA
IAM.USER_NO_MFA.remediation: Enable MFA for this user, or remove the console password if they only need API access.

IAM.CREDENTIALS_UNUSED.title: Credential unused for 45+ days
IAM.CREDENTIALS_UNUSED.remediation: Deactivate or delete the unused password / access key. Unused credentials are pure risk.

IAM.KEY_NOT_ROTATED.title: Access key older than 90 days
IAM.KEY_NOT_ROTATED.remediation: Rotate the key: create a new one, move workloads to it, then deactivate and delete the old one.

IAM.MULTIPLE_ACTIVE_KEYS.title: User has two active access keys
IAM.MULTIPLE_ACTIVE_KEYS.remediation: Keep one active key per user; deactivate the other once nothing uses it.

IAM.NO_PASSWORD_POLICY.title: No account password policy
IAM.NO_PASSWORD_POLICY.remediation: Set a password policy: minimum length 14 and prevent reuse of the last 24 passwords.

IAM.WEAK_PASSWORD_POLICY.title: Password policy weaker than CIS baseline
IAM.WEAK_PASSWORD_POLICY.remediation: Raise the minimum length to 14 and prevent reuse of the last 24 passwords.

IAM.USER_DIRECT_POLICY.title: Permissions attached directly to a user
IAM.USER_DIRECT_POLICY.remediation: Grant permissions through groups or roles, so access is reviewed and revoked in one place.

IAM.FULL_ADMIN_POLICY.title: Customer policy grants full admin (*:*)
IAM.FULL_ADMIN_POLICY.remediation: Replace '*:*' with the actions and resources the holder actually needs.

IAM.ESCALATION_PRIMITIVE.title: Policy grants a privilege-escalation action
IAM.ESCALATION_PRIMITIVE.remediation: Remove the admin-equivalent action (e.g. iam:CreatePolicyVersion, iam:AttachUserPolicy) or scope it to specific resources.

IAM.ROLE_TRUSTS_ANYONE.title: Role trust policy allows any principal
IAM.ROLE_TRUSTS_ANYONE.remediation: Name the specific principals allowed to assume the role instead of '*'.

IAM.ROLE_CROSS_ACCOUNT_NO_EXTERNAL_ID.title: Cross-account role trust without an external ID
IAM.ROLE_CROSS_ACCOUNT_NO_EXTERNAL_ID.remediation: Add an sts:ExternalId condition to the trust policy (the confused-deputy protection).

CRED.KEY_IN_S3.title: AWS access key found in an S3 object
CRED.KEY_IN_S3.remediation: Deactivate the exposed key immediately, delete the object, and rotate anything the key could reach.

S3.PUBLIC_BUCKET.title: S3 bucket is publicly accessible
S3.PUBLIC_BUCKET.remediation: Remove the public grant (policy Principal '*' or AllUsers ACL) and enable Block Public Access.

S3.BLOCK_PUBLIC_ACCESS_OFF.title: S3 Block Public Access not fully enabled
S3.BLOCK_PUBLIC_ACCESS_OFF.remediation: Turn on all four Block Public Access settings for the bucket (and at account level).

S3.NO_DEFAULT_ENCRYPTION.title: S3 bucket has no default encryption
S3.NO_DEFAULT_ENCRYPTION.remediation: Enable default encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS) on the bucket.

EC2.IMDSV1_ALLOWED.title: Instance allows IMDSv1
EC2.IMDSV1_ALLOWED.remediation: Require IMDSv2 (HttpTokens=required). IMDSv1 is how SSRF bugs steal instance-role credentials.

EC2.PUBLIC_IP.title: Instance has a public IP
EC2.PUBLIC_IP.remediation: Only expose instances that must be reachable; put others behind a load balancer or private subnet.

EC2.EBS_UNENCRYPTED.title: EBS volume is unencrypted
EC2.EBS_UNENCRYPTED.remediation: Snapshot the volume, copy the snapshot with encryption on, and replace the volume.

EC2.EBS_DEFAULT_ENCRYPTION_OFF.title: EBS encryption-by-default is off
EC2.EBS_DEFAULT_ENCRYPTION_OFF.remediation: Enable EBS encryption by default in every region you use (a per-region account setting).

VPC.SG_ALL_TRAFFIC_OPEN.title: Security group allows all traffic from the internet
VPC.SG_ALL_TRAFFIC_OPEN.remediation: Replace the 0.0.0.0/0 all-traffic rule with the specific ports and sources needed.

VPC.SG_ADMIN_PORTS_OPEN.title: SSH/RDP open to the internet
VPC.SG_ADMIN_PORTS_OPEN.remediation: Restrict port 22/3389 to known IPs, or use SSM Session Manager and close them entirely.

VPC.SG_DATABASE_PORTS_OPEN.title: Database port open to the internet
VPC.SG_DATABASE_PORTS_OPEN.remediation: Databases should never accept connections from 0.0.0.0/0; restrict to application security groups.

VPC.DEFAULT_SG_NOT_RESTRICTED.title: Default security group allows traffic
VPC.DEFAULT_SG_NOT_RESTRICTED.remediation: Remove all rules from the default security group so nothing is attached to it by accident.

VPC.NACL_ADMIN_PORTS_OPEN.title: Network ACL allows SSH/RDP from the internet
VPC.NACL_ADMIN_PORTS_OPEN.remediation: Deny inbound 22/3389 from 0.0.0.0/0 in the network ACL (defence in depth behind security groups).

LAMBDA.URL_NO_AUTH.title: Lambda function URL needs no authentication
LAMBDA.URL_NO_AUTH.remediation: Set the function URL AuthType to AWS_IAM, or remove the URL if it is not meant to be public.

LAMBDA.SECRET_IN_ENV.title: Possible secret in Lambda environment variables
LAMBDA.SECRET_IN_ENV.remediation: Move secrets to Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store and read them at runtime.

LAMBDA.DEPRECATED_RUNTIME.title: Lambda uses a deprecated runtime
LAMBDA.DEPRECATED_RUNTIME.remediation: Upgrade to a supported runtime; deprecated ones receive no security patches.

RDS.PUBLIC.title: RDS instance is publicly accessible
RDS.PUBLIC.remediation: Set PubliclyAccessible=false and reach the database from inside the VPC.

RDS.UNENCRYPTED.title: RDS storage is unencrypted
RDS.UNENCRYPTED.remediation: Encrypted storage can only be set at creation: snapshot, copy encrypted, and restore.

RDS.NO_DELETION_PROTECTION.title: RDS deletion protection is off
RDS.NO_DELETION_PROTECTION.remediation: Enable deletion protection on databases that hold data you cannot lose.

SECRETS.PUBLIC_POLICY.title: Secret's resource policy allows any principal
SECRETS.PUBLIC_POLICY.remediation: Remove Principal '*' from the secret's resource policy, or add conditions that pin it down.

KMS.PUBLIC_POLICY.title: KMS key policy allows any principal
KMS.PUBLIC_POLICY.remediation: Remove Principal '*' from the key policy, or add conditions that pin it down.

KMS.NO_ROTATION.title: KMS key rotation is off
KMS.NO_ROTATION.remediation: Enable automatic rotation for customer-managed symmetric keys.

CLOUDTRAIL.NOT_ENABLED.title: No multi-region CloudTrail trail is logging
CLOUDTRAIL.NOT_ENABLED.remediation: Create a multi-region trail that logs management events, so activity in the account is recorded.

CLOUDTRAIL.NO_LOG_VALIDATION.title: CloudTrail log file validation is off
CLOUDTRAIL.NO_LOG_VALIDATION.remediation: Enable log file validation so tampering with the logs can be detected.

CLOUDTRAIL.NOT_KMS_ENCRYPTED.title: CloudTrail logs not encrypted with KMS
CLOUDTRAIL.NOT_KMS_ENCRYPTED.remediation: Encrypt the trail's logs with a customer-managed KMS key.
